challenge_focus: The user asked, in their words: "使用orca ，ccl-skills技能体系，架构清晰，领域模型，设计优雅， code clean, 产品设计，终端开发技能，用户体验，交接新会话继续迭代". This change refactors skills/code-review/scripts/review_diff.py into the review flow (review_diff.py) and one adapter per reviewer CLI (review_diff_clients.py), keeping the result envelope, receipt, stdout, prompts and every client launch identical, and adds stderr progress, a summary with a next step for inconclusive results, and exit 2 instead of 1 or 120 when a git failure, an unwritable result, an internal error or a closed stdout/stderr would misreport the verdict. Plan and evidence: specs/diff-first-review/plan.md, Round 3. Look hardest at behavior the refactor could have changed (client argv, environment, private homes, when config is read, family rules, the try-next loop, result fields) and at the new exit and stderr paths.
